60050201.text: Um... Do you think Ineffa will like this gift we got her?

60050204.text: Are you sure? 'Cause when I asked it who's the better hero, Ixquieh or Lianca, it gave the exact same answer...

60050206.text: Hey, you hear that? That's the answer it gave when I asked who'd win in a fight between Cacucu and Ajaw!

60050207.text: You guys, it's just making random beeps!

60050208.text: Whoa! Is that... "Tuma{RUBY#[S]Hope}ini" and the flying{RUBY#[D]Paimon} expert?

60050209.text: ...Uh, beep beep, yes, it's us! Anyway — where's Ineffa?

60050210.text: Probably out mopping up those mad machines, as usual. There must be a lot of them, 'cause she hardly ever comes back for a rest...

60050211.text: Wait, all by herself? Are we sure that's a good idea after what happened last time...?

60050212.text: Umm, Ineffa said that since she lost her memories, her... "cognition module's been running more smoothly." And it's... "greatly boosted efficiency in cleaning and tidying tasks"... I think that was it.

60050213.text: Huh... So, losing her memories has somehow made her a better fighter?

60050214.text: She's awesome! I saw her carrying a whole pile of beaten-up machines in one hand!

60050215.text: All the grown-ups say that they feel much safer leaving the house now, thanks to her. So we thought it'd be nice to give her a little gift.

60050216.text: We've tried giving her flowers and feathers, but it seemed like she didn't like them very much... That got us thinking — maybe robot people don't like the same things as us.

60050217.text: Uh-huh... So that's why you made her this flower out of mechanical parts?

60050218.text: Yeah... we still don't know if she'll like it, though...

60050219.text: It's okay, Adieta! She'll love this one, I'm sure of it!

60050220.text: But... What if she doesn't? This might be my last chance...

60050221.text: Last chance? What do you mean?

60050222.text: Well... Now that all of my mom and dad's other friends from Nod-Krai have left to go home, it's just us left... And they said today, it's our turn to go home too.

60050223.text: Already? Wasn't the plan to stick around until Ineffa gets better?

60050224.text: Dad says everyone back home is expecting us, and he doesn't want us to overstay our welcome here.

60050225.text: He thought we should at least make sure Ineffa wasn't getting any worse first, but now that it's been a few days, he says it's time we made a move.

60050226.text: To be honest, I can kinda understand. He hasn't been home in so many years. Mom and I can tell that he misses Liyue a lot...

60050227.text: Ah, no wonder... So, what about your mom then? Guessing she's not from Liyue?

60050228.text: No, she's from Nod-Krai. She met my dad after he moved there. I was born there, too.

60050229.text: He's been there the whole time I was growing up, so... he hasn't been home in at least ten years.

60050230.text: That's a long time... No wonder he's getting homesick.

60050231.text: Don't worry! We'll write to you and let you know how Ineffa's doing!

60050232.text: You bet! And once she's all better, we'll bring her to visit you in Liyue!

60050233.text: Yeah! So don't worry too much about the flower. I'm sure she'll love it, but even if not, you'll have other chances in the future!

60050236.text: Although... I guess we still need to wait till she gets back. I wonder how much longer she'll be?

60050237.text: Who knows... Seems like she takes longer and longer every time she goes out.

60050238.text: Can't we go take it to her? No, wait... the grown-ups would never let us do that. Way too many of those mad machines out there.

60050239.text: What am I gonna do? If she doesn't get back soon, I might run out of time...

60050240.text: I can deliver it to her for you.

60050403.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon... Annihilation mode disengaged. Chat mode activated.

60050404.text: Chat mode, huh? You'd probably get along well with a Fontainian magician friend of ours... She does "modes" instead of "moods," too.

60050405.text: Good morning. Nice to see you again. What lovely weather we're having.

60050406.text: Good morning. Nice to see you again too. It is lovely, isn't it.

60050407.text: Hey, don't you start too! One robot's enough!

60050408.text: These are some standard greetings I learned recently. Three greetings in a row equals thrice the greetment. Hypothetically speaking.

60050409.text: Where did you get "greetment" from...? Never mind, you're doing a whole lot better than the last time we met.

60050410.text: Yes. My cognition and language modules are recovering well. I can now sustain fluid conversation.

60050411.text: ...But I have still been unable to retrieve the memory containing the code to the cryptex. I will keep trying. Sincere apologies.

60050414.text: Yes. Now that a convenient moment to change the topic has presented itself, what is that object in your hand? A new model of source mechanism?

60050415.text: It's a... "flower." Adieta made it for you.

60050416.text: "Flower"...? Flowers are plant reproductive organs... But I detect no signs of life.

60050417.text: Uh, it's more like a... flower built from mechanical components.

60050418.text: Understood. A flower-shaped machine component... What is its function? Which module is it designed for? Is it compatible with my hardware?

60050419.text: Uhh... It doesn't have a "function," it's just for looking at. Y'know... a cute little souvenir.

60050420.text: Cute little souvenir... But if it serves no function, for what purpose was it built?

60050421.text: This conversation just got really deep!

60050422.text: A cryptex is for sending messages, machines are for performing tasks... What about this flower? What is it for?

60050423.text: I guess... it's to express gratitude.

60050425.text: Yeah. If someone helps you out, you help them back, and if someone gives you a gift, you get them something in return. That's how we show gratitude to other people.

60050426.text: ...The Flower-Feather Clan took me in, so I'm neutralizing threats near their territory. Like that?

60050427.text: Yes, exactly! You got it! So, it all makes sense now, right?

60050428.text: But... is this not "tit-for-tat"? I heard Mr. Kinich use this term.

60050501.text: I can't thank you enough for hosting us these past few days... And thanks for agreeing to look after Ineffa. I know it's a lot to ask.

60050502.text: It's alright. She'll be in good hands.

60050503.text: She never came back... I guess I'll have to leave without saying goodbye...

60050504.text: Hey now, you'll see her again! And we have so much to look forward to in Liyue. All those Xiao Lanterns lighting up the sky. You've always wanted to see that!

60050505.text: Adieta, Aamu, Zhuoxin. I am back.

60050506.text: Huh... Ineffa? ...You brought her back? Thanks so much!

60050509.text: Adieta says a reluctant goodbye to Ineffa...

60050510.text: What does it feel like... to know where you are returning to?

60050511.text: Hmm? That's a strange question... As soon as you're all better, you'll be returning to Nod-Krai!

60050512.text: Oh, and we forgot to say — we're actually heading there ourselves soon. Maybe we can travel together!

60050516.text: All the memory data that has presented itself recently has been related to Natlan. But the merchants tell me that I have "family" waiting for me in Nod-Krai...

60050517.text: If I do recover my memories, which time period will they be from? And will the post-recovery me be the same "me" that I am now, or someone different?

60050519.text: What is it that you're afraid of? Are you worried the new you will be so different, you don't even recognize her?

60050521.text: ...Yes. Once I have been "split"... will it change the way I define "home"?

60050522.text: Huh... Now that's a tough question. A lot of people, and a lot of saurians, spend their whole lives searching for an answer to that.

60050523.text: But if you want my opinion, home is... somewhere you can always return to, wherever that might be.

60050524.text: No matter how far you fly, there'll always be someone back there waiting for you. No matter how battered and bruised you get, you can always go back there to rest and recover.

60050525.text: I guess you could say, it's somewhere you... belong?

60050527.text: Wherever it is that your memories guide you back to... I'm sure it'll be somewhere you feel safe. Somewhere you feel you belong.

60050528.text: Of course, everyone's situation is different, and I don't know how applicable my experience is in your case. But... consider it a reference point, I guess?

60050530.text: Heh, and at the end of the day, I mean, who says you can't have more than one home? There's no law against it.

60050532.text: Hmm? Someone's looking for us? Hopefully, this means there's been some progress.

60050533.text: ...Don't be afraid to recover your memories. They might contain the answers you're looking for.

60050536.text: Malfunction... Have you forgotten why you cast them away to begin with?

60050601.text: Oh, it's Citlali! Didn't think it'd be you.

60050602.text: #Why? Don't you think I'd want to do my part to help {NICKNAME}? ...And anyway, no one's more qualified than the Masters of the Night-Wind when it comes to Natlan's ancient history.

60050604.text: ...If you think I didn't hear that, you're sorely mistaken. But anyway, back to the matter at hand. I don't know if you noticed, but Kinich's little sidekick has been acting a little strange around Ineffa.

60050605.text: Ajaw? Yeah, you can say that again.

60050606.text: After you parted ways, Kinich put him in timeout for three whole days and nights. Then, he had Ifa send Cacucu to torment him for another night...

60050609.text: Finally, Ajaw got so infuriated with Cacucu's pestering that he lost his cool and let slip a crucial piece of information. Two words: "Sovereign ruler."

60050611.text: Sovereign ruler? So what, isn't that just how he introduces himself?

60050612.text: It is, and I always assumed it was a load of hot air... But apparently not. Turns out, the title refers to the thirteen dragonlords who ruled Natlan in ancient times.

60050703.text: Well, Citlali hasn't told you everything. There's another sovereign ruler that Ineffa might be connected to, not just the one from the Flower-Feather Clan.

60050704.text: All trace of this other sovereign ruler was lost after the war. The records claim that in their final battle, they fought against Ixquieh... and Lianca.

60050705.text: What!? Why didn't you say anything?

60050706.text: It was my idea. I suggested we bring up the dragon mother first and see how Ineffa responds. And, well... Citlali has debriefed me on how it went.

60050707.text: Apparently, she barely reacted — despite a very strong reaction to the name "Lianca"... To me, that says we need to tread very carefully when probing her about the Eleventh Lord.

60050709.text: She's the one who went missing after the war. Said to be the proudest of all the sovereign rulers — and the most hostile towards humanity.

60050710.text: When the Pyro Dragon fell, she couldn't accept that dragonkind had been defeated. She sank into despair and insanity...

60050711.text: But the rest is lost to history. There's no way to find out what became of her, or even what her name was.

60050712.text: Remember, though — in essence, these sovereign rulers weren't physical entities, but pure intelligence, built with secret source technology.

60050713.text: I mean, who knows what happens when a manufactured mind goes mad? Maybe she lost her power and memories... maybe she split into different personalities.

60050714.text: Are you saying what I think you're saying?

60050715.text: The point is, if Ineffa really does originate from the Eleventh Lord, then we need to...

60050716.text: What, have her taken out? Because of some baseless speculation? How would that be any different from what they did to Lianca's mother?

60050717.text: Chasca? Wh—What, uh, brings you here...?

60050718.text: Anyone with a brain could see you were up to something back there... Unless it's a Paimon-brain. Or a robot-brain.

60050719.text: #...Okay, you got us. Actually, we never intended to cut you out of this, it's just that Citlali's spell only works on {NICKNAME}.

60050720.text: But Chasca, I'm telling you — we have legitimate concerns here. This is not baseless speculation.

60050721.text: Ever since Ineffa set sail for Natlan, the secret source automatons have been getting increasingly aggressive... It's as if they're drawn to each other.

60050722.text: ...Ineffa could well be the Eleventh Lord herself. And if so, then the moment she recovers her memory, all of us — all of humanity — will instantly become her enemy.

60050723.text: I've been keeping an eye on her movements at the Flower-Feather Clan. Whatever she was in the past, and whoever she becomes in the future, I trust who she is today.

60050724.text: Even if the past and future Ineffa are a completely different person from who she is now?

60050725.text: Heh... If you're suggesting that there's a volatile force within her, threatening to rise up and take over at any given moment... That makes two of us.

60050726.text: But no one ever gave up on me. Not momma bird, not Chuychu, not my dad... So what right do I have to give up on her?

60050727.text: If Lianca was here... I have every confidence that she'd say the same.

60050728.text: Besides, even if the Eleventh Lord rises again and declares all of us her enemy, the solution is simple: We defeat her. The heroes managed it, so there's no reason we can't too.

60050729.text: Especially with Tumaini on the team.

60050730.text: *sigh*... Fine, fine. I had a feeling this might be your reaction.

60050731.text: Look, I get it — you're only acting like the villain here to make us realize how serious the situation is. You know how I know that? Because when I was a kid, and they brought me to you for treatment, you didn't give up on me either.

60050732.text: Yeah, well, playing the villain is a force of habit for old Granny by this point... Just know you've been warned, alright? Watch out for any new developments, and make sure you know where she is at all times...

60050733.text: (Haha, that really sounded like a granny talking to a rebellious teen...)

60050734.text: (Hey! The spell hasn't worn off yet, you know!)

60050735.text: Ahem... Anyway, now that we're all caught up, you should get back on Ineffa watch, and we should get back to investigating...

60050736.text: Help, someone...! Oh... Chasca? What are you all doing here? And when did Xilonen show up?

60050737.text: Paimon? You were supposed to stay with Ineffa...

60050738.text: Oh, right, Ineffa! Something weird happened. She got halfway through those woven scrolls, and then flew off all of a sudden! Paimon tried to stop her, but she wouldn't come back!

60050739.text: Did something trigger a new memory? This doesn't make any sense... She barely responded when we were chatting. What could it be?

60050740.text: No idea... But it must be something important, 'cause she sure looked like she was in a hurry... Also, she said... "Annihilation mode activated"!

60050741.text: ...! Okay, Chasca, you're our eye in the sky — find out where she's gone. We'll inform everyone else, tell them to be on high alert.

60050744.text: Wait, don't you wanna discuss this first— Hey, wait up!

60050803.text: Whoa, are these all secret source automatons?

60051003.text: Ugh! Boss, what do we do now?

60051004.text: We've tried the same thing several times now, and it isn't working. We can't keep waiting around for her to leave the settlement...

60051006.text: ...Well, well. An ancient relic from Natlan's dragon civilization? Hmph...

60051007.text: If you want to play with fire, then be my guest. But there is an unpredictable variable you need to watch out for...

60051008.text: ...Let's fall back. This isn't worth the risk.

60051011.text: I'll be okay, I just hurt my ankle... Ineffa got here just in time...

60051012.text: Why would they do this? Ugh... Argh! Why!!!

60051013.text: No one could have known the automatons would ambush you here. Don't blame yourself.

60051015.text: Wait... Ineffa, how did you know to come here? Did you sense that they were in danger?

60051016.text: Yes, I... heard the secret source automatons... talking.

60051018.text: Even now, I still hear them.

60051020.text: ...Hypothesis: language module requires translation functionality... Please wait...

60051023.text: That was quick... How come you're so familiar with their architecture?

60051024.text: I have... seen them many times before. At least, I think so.

60051025.text: Hmm. More random memory data, I guess...

60051028.text: Hey! What do you think you're playing at? Why did you attack us!?

60051029.text: ...Under... Fatui... control... they... made us... attack...

60051032.text: How is that possible? The Captain's soldiers certainly aren't capable of this, and besides — we know everything they're up to... Has another Fatui regiment infiltrated Natlan?

60051034.text: Ugh, why's it getting so choppy? Bad signal, maybe?

60051035.text: Hypothesis: Distance to signal source increasing, transmission compromised. Combining these words with what I have heard so far, I believe the full message should be:

60051036.text: "The Fatui invaded my territory, so the automatons went haywire."

60051037.text: Oh... So all the recent automaton attacks — the Fatui were behind it all along?

60051039.text: "They stole my privileges and took control of the automatons."

60051042.text: Mirror of the Dawning Morn... detected... sending... request... restore...

60051043.text: "Mirror of the Dawning Morn detected nearby. Now sending request for Mirror of the Dawning Morn to restore my privileges."

60051044.text: "Mirror of the Dawning Morn"? Who or what is that?

60051045.text: Hypothesis: This appears to refer to me... or more specifically, to my core.

60051046.text: Mirror of the Dawning Morn... return... core...

60051047.text: I think... she wants me to go with her to return the core. So she can repair the damage done by the Fatui.

60051048.text: Wait, you mean... she knows you?

60051049.text: Yes. Before the translation began, she referred to me by a different name: "Eleventh Lord."

60051051.text: (So Ineffa is the missing sovereign ruler who fought against Lianca?)

60051052.text: What!? So... Ineffa is the eleventh sovereign ruler!?

60051053.text: Hold on... This automaton just attacked us moments ago. We shouldn't trust everything it says.

60051054.text: You say Ineffa is the Eleventh Lord. What proof do you have?

60051058.text: She said, return to the Eighth Lord's territory, and I can restore all of my memory data.

60051059.text: Eighth Lord... Lianca's mother's territory? What does the Eleventh Lord have to do with that?

60051061.text: Uhh, this is getting weirder by the second... What did she say this time?

60051063.text: #The signal should improve as we get closer to her territory. {NICKNAME}, Chasca, shall we proceed?

60051064.text: Wait! ...Um... You should think this through carefully...

60051065.text: I... may know a thing or two about the Fatui regiment that entered Natlan recently. They're kind of a special ops team... definitely not your average soldiers.

60051067.text: They've been showing up everywhere, hungrily searching for secret knowledge about all kinds of ancient civilizations... they say they're trying to make some sort of... "inference."

60051068.text: The leader of this regiment is a harbinger based in Nod-Krai... known as "Marionette."

60051069.text: Marionette? ...How exactly do you know all this?

60051070.text: I, uh... heard bits and pieces at the market in Nasha Town. But I figured they were just rumors. Didn't realize it was true...

60051071.text: Is that right? How come I'm only hearing about this now?

60051072.text: I'm sorry... I was so preoccupied with getting ready for the journey, and like I said, I thought they were just rumors anyway... Didn't wanna worry you...

60051073.text: So these Fatui are soldiers, huh? Who's stronger, them or Ineffa?

60051074.text: Ineffa, of course! Haha... But still... maybe you should tread carefully here? Ineffa's already had to rescue us so many times now, I... I'd be mortified if anything happened to you.

60051075.text: ...You're right. First things first, Aamu's injured — we should take her back to the tribe and get her checked out. And as for this "Eleventh Lord" business... We need to discuss this with the others before deciding how to proceed.

60051076.text: (An Eleventh Lord with her memories back will probably see humanity as her enemy... Xilonen and Citlali's worst fears might be coming true. We need to tell them.)

60051078.text: Look, I know the news about the Eighth Lord and Marionette is very concerning... But we should probably come up with a plan before checking things out.

60051083.text: #{NICKNAME}, Ineffa, could you check that the coast is clear? I'm gonna patch up Aamu, then head out.

60051085.text: ...Adieta, I need you to go keep mom company while the doctor takes a look at her. Dad has some things to take care of, so I'll be staying out here a while longer...

60051086.text: You're not coming back with us? Why not?

60051087.text: Dad's gotta pack up the luggage and make sure all our goods are safe! Don't forget, they're our ticket to a great new life in Liyue!

60051088.text: Don't worry, Dad will be back very soon... I'm sorry girls, I promise it's going to be okay.

60051089.text: I'll get help as quickly as I can. If anything happens, save yourselves first.

60051090.text: ...Huh? Why'd it stop moving? Has it malfunctioned on us?

60051301.text: ...You're saying Zhuoxin might be a Fatui spy? And he's staying behind as their eyes on the ground?

60051302.text: But... Should we really leave Ineffa here too? Not that I don't trust her, it's just... are you sure you'll be okay keeping an eye on her by yourself?

60051306.text: ...You're not wrong. We need all the intel we can get on Marionette and the Fatui — as far as I'm concerned, they're a bigger threat than any sovereign ruler.

60051307.text: Still, even with your abilities, be sure to stay on your guard. And not just because of the Fatui and the Eleventh Lord... it's that automaton, too. I'm still not convinced we can trust it.

60051308.text: Why the sudden request for assistance from the Eighth Lord's territory? Are we supposed to believe that Lianca's mother survived? Surely, there'd be at least some mention of that in the tribal legends... I don't know, something just doesn't add up.

60051309.text: Hey, Chasca! Aamu's ready to go!

60051310.text: That's my cue... I'll be back with the others as soon as I've gotten Aamu and Adieta to safety. If you have to leave the area for any reason... be sure to leave a trail.

60051313.text: ...He's on the move! So much for keeping the goods safe... Do we think he's going to meet someone?

60051314.text: Should we tail him? He won't know he's being followed — this could be our chance to get our hands on some really useful intel! Either about the sovereign rulers or this "Marionette" person...

60051316.text: ...Let's do it. Make sure you leave a trail, so we can be traced.

subQuests.subQuestName: Keep your distance and follow Zhuoxin
Keep your distance and follow Zhuoxin

60051201.text: Now, why would someone dig a random tunnel in the middle of nowhere? Unless... it's the entrance to one of the sovereign rulers' territories?

60051202.text: Territory... sealed by Lianca... This was... once one of... the secondary access tunnels...

60051203.text: Hey, that was pretty clear this time. What's changed?

60051205.text: ...Getting closer... increased activity in language module...

60051208.text: Huh? You're breaking up again... Looks like the signal's still pretty choppy.

60051209.text: ...Lianca sealed... territory... stop Och-Kan... finding it...

60051210.text: Later... Fatui... weak point... broke in...

60051211.text: Sounds like those Fatui have made this their stronghold... Well, this is probably a good point to stop and wait for reinforcements.

60051212.text: What do you think? Ineffa... Oh no! What's she doing!? She charged right in!

60051213.text: *sigh* I take my eyes off her for two seconds, and now this...

60051215.text: #{NICKNAME}, are we going after her? Or waiting here?

60051219.text: Alright then... But let's be careful!

60055101.text: All the grown-ups I know who've been to Liyue say it's a really beautiful place! They have loads of cool toys there too, right?

60055102.text: Umm... I only know what my dad's told me. He said there's a toy seller at Chihu Rock...

60055104.text: Once you get there, you have to write to us and tell us all about it!

60055201.text: ...Would a machine created by dragons really betray its own kind? Hmm... She seemed to approve of the path her daughter took — but what about her? What path did she take?

60055202.text: None of the legends of Lianca say anything about her dragon mother defecting to humanity and fighting against dragonkind... Sounds like speculation to me. Maybe the other sovereign rulers just didn't trust her.

60055203.text: So mean! Hmm... Do you think it's possible that Lianca found a way to secretly save the priestess of... uhh, flower-feather... something?

60059902.text: (...Now's your chance. Slip away quietly while they've got their heads buried in those woven scrolls. Meet me at the other side of the settlement.)
